Have you heard of parakaryon? It was a single cell organism found off of the coast of Japan on an underwater thermal vent. It has characteristics of both prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, making it the only organism scientists have no idea where it sits on the tree of life.
They are reasonably confident that parakaryon wasn't a result of parasitism by a bacteria or anything. Of course it could be a fluke, but it could still be an actual thing.
